headline: US stocks closed higher as easing oil and Treasury yields lifted tech ahead of Nvidia earnings and key PCE inflation data
raw_text:
- The S&P 500 (SPX) rose 0.32% to 7,677.28, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJI) gained 0.30% (+160 points) to 53,577.40, the Nasdaq added 0.66% to 26,151.30, and the Russell 2000 (IWM) climbed about 0.5% to 3,010.02.
- Nine of 11 S&P sectors closed higher, led by technology and communication services, while energy lagged as oil (@CL) fell below $88 per barrel and Treasury yields retreated.
- Chipmakers advanced ahead of Nvidia (NVDA)’s earnings, with Nvidia (NVDA) up about 2.2%, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) nearly 5% on an upgrade, Micron (MU) roughly 2.5%, and the PHLX Semiconductor Index gaining 1.4%.
- Meta Platforms (META) rose nearly 2% after Evercore ISI raised its price target to $860 from $820 on AI compute monetization opportunity.
- Dick’s Sporting Goods (DKS) dropped an estimated 25–27% intraday after Q2 adjusted EPS of $3.53 missed expectations of $3.76 and the company cut its fiscal 2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance to $11.00–$12.00 from $13.50–$14.50, citing Foot Locker weakness and margin pressure.
- Target (TGT) fell about 5% on sympathy from Dick’s Sporting Goods (DKS) earnings miss.
- Among smaller names, Rezolve AI (RZLV) gained 21.81% on a Google Cloud partnership, Critical Metals (CRML) rose 21.44% on project timeline updates, and AbCellera Biologics (ABCL) advanced 17.81% on positive Phase 2 data.
- Penny stocks Xiao-I Corp (AIXI) and Netcapital (NCPL) jumped more than 180% and more than 120%, respectively, on heavy volume driven by ADS ratio news and retail momentum with zero borrow.
- Canada announced retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion of U.S. goods, including steel and aluminum, effective September 8, with investors hoping the impact remains contained.
- Options on Nvidia (NVDA) priced in roughly a 5.4% post-earnings move, implying about a $280 billion swing in market value, as traders looked ahead to results from Nvidia (NVDA), Salesforce (CRM), and CrowdStrike (CRWD) on Wednesday and to July PCE inflation data amid ongoing diplomacy efforts around Iran.

- **Chipmakers advanced** ahead of Nvidia ([NVDA](https://finviz.com/quote?t=NVDA))’s earnings, with **Nvidia** ([NVDA](https://finviz.com/quote?t=NVDA)) up about **2.2%**, **Advanced Micro Devices** ([AMD](https://finviz.com/quote?t=AMD)) nearly **5%** on an upgrade, **Micron** ([MU](https://finviz.com/quote?t=MU)) roughly **2.5%**, and the **PHLX Semiconductor Index** gaining **1.4%**.

- **Canada announced retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion of U.S. goods**, including steel and aluminum, effective **September 8**, with investors hoping the impact remains contained.
- Options on **Nvidia** ([NVDA](https://finviz.com/quote?t=NVDA)) priced in roughly a **5.4% post-earnings move**, implying about a **$280 billion** swing in market value, as traders looked ahead to results from **Nvidia** ([NVDA](https://finviz.com/quote?t=NVDA)), **Salesforce** ([CRM](https://finviz.com/quote?t=CRM)), and **CrowdStrike** ([CRWD](https://finviz.com/quote?t=CRWD)) on Wednesday and to **July PCE inflation data** amid ongoing diplomacy efforts around Iran.
